title: The Lies That Made Ads Honest

topic: The real reason behind the NBA's 24-second shot clock.
title: A Basketball Team Owner's Genius Timer Idea
fact: Danny Biasone invented the 24-second shot clock, first used in the NBA on October 30, 1954, in Syracuse, New York.

topic: The origin of the Q-tip 'do not insert into ear canal' warning
title: The tiny stick you're probably using wrong.
fact: Leo Gerstenzang invented Q-tips in 1923 for infant care, but widespread misuse for ear cleaning led to warnings against inserting them into the ear canal.
